note: Forward predictions for 1.18.2, authored by the pred-scout-coach agent on session compute (no API) and grounded in the 2026-11-20 1.18 baseline: pred.gg ranked lane stats (version ids 170+171, ~96,217 matches) and the public match stream (96,299 ranked matches, 2026-11-03 to 11-20) for augments, Eternals and 3-item cores. Forecasts, not measured results; no 1.18.2 games have been counted. The seven new or returning items (Infused Bracers, Stigmata, Bandit's Toll, Heretic's Blade, Shadebinder, Elysia, Kingsbane) have no data. The kit-math sim was not used.

adele.name: Adele
changes: Court Of Roses [Augment]: Vine Ally Damage Modifier increased from 50% to 75%
Base stats: Physical Power Growth increased from 3 to 3.4
Iron Rose [Secondary]: Damage Bonus Health Scaling increased from 0.7% to 1%
Iron Rose [Secondary]: Cooldown decreased from 18/17.25/16.5/15.75/15 to 17/16/15/14/13
Queen's Garden [Ultimate]: Slow increased from 35%/37.5%/40% to 35%/40%/45%
Queen's Garden [Ultimate]: Root Duration increased from 0.5s to 0.75s
adele.why: Iron Rose's cooldown drops from 18-15s to 17-13s and its health scaling rises from 0.7% to 1%. Queen's Garden roots for 0.75s instead of 0.5s and slows up to 45%.
adele.willChange: Expect a clear lift for engage Adele, mostly in fights where the longer root lands. She sat at 49.9% over 11,677 ranked support games. Land Queen's Garden on grouped enemies, then follow with Iron Rose while they are rooted.

akeron.name: Akeron
changes: Consume [Ultimate]: Bite Damage Bonus Physical Power Scaling decreased from 75% to 65%
Consume [Ultimate]: Bite Damage Magical Power Scaling decreased from 40% to 35%
Consume [Ultimate]: Execute Bonus Physical Power Scaling decreased from 3.5% to 3%
Consume [Ultimate]: Execute Bonus Magical Power Scaling decreased from 2.5% to 2%
akeron.why: Consume's bite scaling falls from 75% to 65% bonus physical power and from 40% to 35% magical power, and its execute scaling drops too. Nothing else in his kit changes.
akeron.willChange: Expect a step down when he gets ahead, made larger because Forticus and Nihil, both in his usual offlane setup, are cut too. He sat at 51.5% over 8,181 ranked offlane games. Fight with your team close, since he can no longer finish targets alone as easily.

argus.name: Argus
changes: Base stats: Health decreased from 660 to 650
Base stats: Health Regen decreased from 1.7 to 1.5
argus.why: Base health falls from 660 to 650 and health regen from 1.7 to 1.5. Azure Core, in his most-built midlane core, also loses shield.
argus.willChange: Expect a slight dip, felt in early lane trades. He sat at 52.0% over 13,582 ranked midlane games. With less health and regen, poke now puts him in kill range sooner, so back earlier instead of staying low in lane.

boris.name: Boris
changes: Base stats: Health Growth increased from 130 to 135
Base stats: Mana Growth increased from 40 to 46
Detection Protocol [Primary]: Movement Speed increased from 45%/55%/65%/75%/85% to 45%/60%/75%/90%/105%
Primeval Roar [Secondary]: Magical Power Scaling increased from 70% to 85%
Primeval Roar [Secondary]: Maximum Fear Time increased from 1s to 1.1s
Primeval Roar [Secondary]: Damage Reduction increased from 20%/22.5%/25%/27.5%/30% to 20%/23%/26%/29%/32%
boris.why: Primeval Roar's scaling rises from 70% to 85%, its fear to 1.1s and its damage reduction to 32%. Detection Protocol's speed tops out at 105% instead of 85%.
boris.willChange: Expect a modest climb, mostly late game where he struggled. He sat at 48.7% over 10,942 ranked jungle games. Use Detection Protocol's extra speed to reach the enemy backline, then Roar to fear them while you take less damage.

crunch.name: Crunch
changes: Base stats: Hero Model and Hitbox Size decreased by 5%
crunch.why: His model and hitbox shrink by 5%. Nothing else in his kit or stats changes.
crunch.willChange: Expect little change; a smaller hitbox mostly helps him slip skillshots in fights. He sat at 48.6% over 9,318 ranked offlane games. Mutilator, in his most-built cores, gains Devour damage (3x to 3.5x), so keep building it into health-stacking lanes.

gadget.name: Gadget

Base stats: Health Regen decreased from 1.35 to 1.2
Auto-Lock Amp [Augment]: Seek & Destroy Tracking Speed decreased from 25% to 20%
Sticky Mine [Primary]: Mana Cost increased from 50/55/60/65/70 to 55/60/65/70/75
gadget.why: Base health falls from 640 to 630 and regen from 1.35 to 1.2. Auto-Lock Amp tracks 20% instead of 25%, and Sticky Mine costs 55-75 mana instead of 50-70.
gadget.willChange: Expect a small drop for poke Gadget, who runs dry sooner, most of all in the offlane. She sat at 49.8% over 19,393 ranked midlane games. Auto-Lock Amp follows targets less, so aim mines in the enemy's path and spend them on trades, not waves.

gideon.name: Gideon

Base stats: Health Regen decreased from 1.45 to 1.3
gideon.why: Base health falls from 670 to 650 and health regen from 1.45 to 1.3.
gideon.willChange: Expect a slight dip; lower health means an early poke combo puts him in kill range sooner. He sat at 48.7% over 19,896 ranked midlane games. Winter's Fury can now be used during Black Hole, which makes it a stronger crest for him.

sectionMeta.tldr: 1.18.2 is a durability patch. Thirteen mages lose base health or regen, Forticus and five shield sources shrink, and Kaelen, who sat at 56.8% over 19,912 ranked jungle games, is cut across his kit. Seven items arrive or return for on-hit fighters, bruiser mages and enchanters, with no data yet. Adele, Boris, GRIM.exe, Sevarog, Skylar and Wukong get help.
sectionMeta.heroes: Thirty-two heroes change, and the cuts follow the board: Kaelen at 56.8% over 19,912 jungle games, Narbash at 53.2% over 11,961 support games and Scarlett at 52.0% over 12,327 offlane games. Buffs go to heroes below average, such as Sevarog at 47.5% and GRIM.exe at 47.8%. Thirteen mages lose a little health or regen, so mid lane poke sticks more.
sectionMeta.eternals: No new Eternals. The sustain minors shrink together: From The Abyss and Regenerative Tissue heal less late, Mending at every tier; Regenerative Tissue ran in 78,290 ranked games. Nihil's level-up bonus falls from 20% to 17.5%, The Tenth Seal from 25 to 20 ultimate haste, and Patina from 4% to 3% speed. Pilow's debuff radius grows from 600 to 650.
sectionMeta.items: Seven items are new or returning, with no data yet: Bandit's Toll, Heretic's Blade and Kingsbane for on-hit, Shadebinder for magical bruisers, Elysia for enchanters, plus Stigmata and Infused Bracers. Forticus, in the top cores of 25 hero-roles, now costs 3000 and shields for 6% instead of 8%. Earthshaker, Mutilator, Scattershot and Onixian Quiver get stronger.
sectionMeta.systems: Hybrid Penetration is new: 10 of it gives 10 physical and 10 magical penetration, on Infused Bracers and Kingsbane. Bug fixes touch Aurora, Dekker, Greystone, Zarus and Zinx. Quests change rewards only.

comps.summary: Expect ranked comps to move away from shield stacking toward damage that sticks: mages get squishier, Forticus and mage shields shrink, and Kaelen comes down. These are reads from the notes, not results.

shifts.text: Thirteen mages lose health or regen, so poke now sticks and stalling on regen gets harder. The Fey, at 51.5% over 21,274 midlane games, takes the biggest cut. Expect poke mids and roaming carries to punish slow starts.

shifts.lead: Forticus frontlines lose their safety net
shifts.text: Forticus shields for 6% instead of 8% on a longer cooldown, and Vortex Stone, Vyzar Carapace and Terminus shields shrink. Expect fighters who poached Forticus to return to damage items, while true tanks keep it.

Kaelen sat at 56.8% over 19,912 ranked jungle games, and Forticus was in 1,629 of his listed core games. Expect him to stay a common pick, with buffed Boris, Sevarog and Wukong as other jungle options.
Kingsbane adds an on-hit path for carries, and Bandit's Toll and Heretic's Blade do the same for fighters such as Grux, Serath and Yin. TwinBlast's Vaporize is cut ahead of them.

Elysia gives 25 ultimate haste and faster basic cooldowns after an ultimate; the notes name Zinx, Muriel and Maco. Hexbound Bracers drops from 15 to 10 haste, so expect enchanter supports to move toward Elysia.
